verdict.rationale: Fireflies' security page says Enterprise customers get Private Storage to keep meeting data 'at your preferred location', in dedicated cloud storage for the organization. That is a first-party data-location capability, but it is Enterprise-only and backed by only brief marketing lines. missing for 10: documentation of selectable regions or residency options (e.g., EU/US), configuration steps, availability below Enterprise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
